script_hooks.logic:
Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
Let currentParamSuffixNo be the current form of part.
Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for part under the phases list.
If currentParamSuffixNo is not paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs, then
  Part changes to form paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs.
  Part cancels its cast and stop.
If part is ready to act, then part picks and uses a smart-weighted move.

flow.text: Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
Let currentParamSuffixNo be the current form of part.
Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for part under the phases list.

yes.text: Part picks and uses a smart-weighted move.

script_hooks.logic:
Let part be part 2 of the enemy.
If part is ready to act, then
  Let part2 be part 3 of the enemy.
  If part2 is dead, then part uses the move labelled "over_power_for_buddy" and stop.
  Part uses the move labelled "over_power_for_mortar" with options {forceTargets: [part2]}.
